subject: Brightlane pilot: acceptance criteria & exec readout scheduling
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Pierce <apierce@brightlane.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-28T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Quick recap + ask: pilot acceptance criteria and timeline

Alex — great to meet earlier. Short recap to make sure we’re aligned and to scope the pilot (POC) cleanly so it maps to Brightlane’s decision timeline. Notes from the call: 

- Business goal: reduce triage time for analytics alerts by surfacing model summaries and suggested actions (~30% target).
- Primary workload: structured alert text + enriched metadata (avg prompt ~380 tokens).
- Success metrics discussed: average time-to-action, precision of suggested actions (>= 75%), and no-data-leak requirement for PHI-handling paths.
- Timeline: you’re targeting an exec decision window in early April, procurement needs internal approval by week of Apr 3.

Can you confirm the top 3 acceptance criteria we should bake into the POC matrix? Also: any constraints on test data (can we use anonymized production snapshot), and how final readout scheduling looks from your side (two hour exec slot vs 30-min executive summary)?

I’ll put together a one-sheet POC acceptance matrix and a short runbook with owners — attaching a draft matrix and our runbook template for your review. Proposed internal owners: Ben (technical lead), Priyom (CS/ops owner), me (commercial lead).

Next step from our side: once you confirm acceptance criteria + data constraints, Ben will propose a sprint plan and we’ll lock the exec review windows.

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198
Redwood Inference

Attachments: brightlane_poc_matrix.xlsx (draft), redwood_poc_runbook_v1.pdf (template)

From: Alex Pierce <apierce@brightlane.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Brightlane Procurement <procurement@brightlane.ai>
Date: 2028-03-29T09:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick recap + ask: pilot acceptance criteria and timeline

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the clear notes. Confirming and adding a few specifics.

Acceptance criteria (top 3) — these are the ones our exec committee cares about: 
1) Time-to-action reduction: 25–35% improvement on average across our top 5 alert classes (we can provide baseline samples).
2) Action suggestion precision: post-run human review should agree with suggested action >= 75% on a 200-sample audit.
3) Data-handling: no identifiable PHI leaves our VPC during the pilot; log-level audit and access control must be enabled.

Data constraints: we can provide a sanitized snapshot (we have a preprocessing script to strip identifiers). If you need a live connector we’ll need a security review — prefer snapshot for pilot.

Exec readout: For timing, our COO prefers a concise 30-minute exec summary with 10 minute Q&A (total 40). Ideal slots are Apr 5 10:00–10:40am PT or Apr 6 2:00–2:40pm PT. Procurement: I’ve looped them — procurement needs a statement of work + estimated MRR for production to start their internal routing.

I’m good with your owner list. Please update the matrix with measurable targets and we’ll confirm the sample dataset by EOD tomorrow.

— Alex
Alex Pierce
Head of Product | Brightlane Analytics
apierce@brightlane.ai

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Alex Pierce <apierce@brightlane.ai>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-30T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Proposed pilot run cadence & owner map

Alex / team — thanks for confirming. I’ve updated the attached POC matrix with concrete measurement buckets and a proposed 3-week sprint plan that fits the Apr 5/6 readout windows. Highlights: 

- Week 0 (prep, 2 days): dataset ingest (sanitized snapshot), access reviews, initial baseline run. Owner: Priyom (ops) / Brightlane engineering point.
- Week 1 (model tuning + integration): iterate on prompt templates, KV/cache validation, latency tuning. Owner: Ben (tech lead).
- Week 2 (validation + audit): 200-sample precision audit, KPI dashboard, on-call for any operational issues. Owner: Ben & Priyom.

Deliverables for exec readout (30-min): one-slide KPI snapshot, 3 example alert workflows demonstrating recommended actions, and an ops checklist for production handoff.

Notes on security: we’ll run inside a dedicated VPC connector and provide audit logs (no raw PHI exported). If procurement needs a short security addendum we can provide SOC-2 evidence and the minimal network diagram.

I attached the POC matrix (updated) and runbook (filled for week 0). If this looks good I’ll open calendar invites for the two exec windows you suggested so you can pick.

Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

Attachments: brightlane_poc_matrix.xlsx (updated), redwood_poc_runbook_v1.pdf (filled)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Alex Pierce <apierce@brightlane.ai>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-31T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Exec readout availability + decision ask

Looping in on scheduling/decision path — Marissa/Ben, quick ask: can you prepare a 6-slide readout that maps each acceptance criterion to an explicit pass/fail gate and the exact artifact we’ll hand the Brightlane execs (e.g., KPI slide, audit log sample, 3 annotated workflows)?

Alex — to keep your April decision window intact, we need to lock a single preferred slot by Friday (Apr 1) so we can reserve our execs. Ben — can you confirm the KPI slide will be generated from the validation harness by Apr 3 EOD?

If the execs grant go/no-go, procurement will advance with a 30–60 day MSA + pilot addendum; if no-go, we’ll capture learnings and propose a next-step plan.

Thanks — Soojin
Soojin Lee
VP Sales | Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com

> On Fri, Mar 30, 2028 at 11:20 AM Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com> wrote:

From: Alex Pierce <apierce@brightlane.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Brightlane Procurement <procurement@brightlane.ai>
Date: 2028-04-03T09:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Exec readout availability + decision ask

Thanks all — we’ll take Apr 6 2:00–2:40pm PT for the exec readout (please send calendar invite).

Ben — confirm the KPI slide by EOD Apr 3 as requested. Procurement: we’ll aim to provide a draft SOW and estimated spend by Apr 4 so internal routing can begin. We prefer a short MSA + pilot addendum approach.

Final note on evaluation: Brightlane will run the 200-sample precision audit internally but will share results with Redwood during the readout. If the precision threshold is missed, we’ll discuss mitigation vs extended pilot during the exec call. Looking forward to the run.

— Alex
Alex Pierce
Head of Product | Brightlane Analytics
